meta.kohler_finding: No Kohler-branded or Kohler-linked product is currently live. The 'Arsham in Kohler' collection is empty and the only Kohler artifacts are two 2024 CMS pages holding size-chart images. A site search for 'kohler' returns no Kohler product — only fuzzy matches (Collegiate Sweatshirt, Curry Brand Flyer Mid Layer).
meta.chapter_finding: Nothing on malbon.com describes itself as a 'chapter' or carries a chapter number. Malbon organises these drops by date-coded tags only: '6.16.26 Arsham' (June 16 2026) and '9.10.26 Arsham' (September 10 2026). The early-access landing page /pages/ea-arsham reads only '9.10.26 @ 9am PST / EARLY ACCESS'. Do not attribute a chapter number to Malbon without an off-site source.
meta.date_caveat: published_at and created_at are Shopify store records, NOT announcement or campaign dates. Many September products were created_at 2026-06-10 (built alongside the June drop) and only published_at 2026-09-10. Two June products (Fairway Stealth Polo white/black, Fire At Will Tee) were re-published 2026-08-14, which is a restock/re-publish event, not a launch.
meta.gender_finding: All 37 pieces are men's/unisex. Every garment runs a single XS-XXL size curve; accessories run OS or S/M-L/XL. Product types map to Malbon's men's navigation (Polos, Quarter Zips, Windshirt, Pants, Shorts, T-Shirts, Sweatshirts, Hats) plus ungendered golf categories (Headcovers, Golf Bags, Gloves, Golf Equipment). There is no womenswear-specific Arsham product — no Skirts, Dresses, Knitwear or Tees & Tanks entries exist in the collection.

products.title: ARSHAM FAIRWAY STEALTH POLO
products.description: The Fairway Stealth Polo reworks a classic performance silhouette through the Malbon & Arsham Stealth Camo print. Built from stretch fabrication with a self-fabric collar, the polo is finished with Malbon engraved buttons and collaborative artwork at the chest for a technical take on an everyday course staple.

products.title: ARSHAM STEALTH PANT
technical_details: Zip fly with Malbon silicone zipper pull
products.description: The Stealth Pant brings a technical edge to a clean, straight-leg silhouette. Built from four-way stretch twill with a DW finish, it combines flexible movement with functional pocketing, an elasticized waistband, and Malbon & Arsham artwork for a versatile performance bottom designed on and off the course.
